item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces ended a ten-day siege of Hebron, withdrawing after detaining residents and threatening a broader West Bank offensive. In Gaza, the IDF killed six Hamas operatives, including two who participated in the Oct 7 attack, and a separate strike killed one person and wounded five. Iran warned it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if its conditions are met. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
